caseNameFull: Wolf v. Schram, Receiver and Davis v. Same
attorneys: Mr. William Alfred Lucking for. petitioners. Messrs. Frank E. Wood and Robert S. Marx for respondent.

opinions.text:
Petitions for writs of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit denied.

Mr. Justice Reed took no part in the consideration and decision of these applications.

Reported below: 111 F. 2d 144, 146.
